sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女尸。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到斩首，体内的血液也被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名女尸。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于得知了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“档案档案呈献”推出的全新系列，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: In the autumn of 1998, 23-year-old Amy Lynn Bradley was told by her parents that they had been gifted a Caribbean cruise.
sentences.zh: 1998年秋天，23岁的埃米·林恩·布拉德利被父母告知，他们得到了一次加勒比海游轮之旅的赠票。

sentences.en: Amy wasn't excited by the news like they were.
sentences.zh: 埃米并没有像父母那样对这个消息感到兴奋。

sentences.en: She had only just moved into her own apartment after graduating from her degree in physical education, and she was just about to start a new job.
sentences.zh: 她刚从体育教育专业毕业并搬进自己的公寓，正准备开始一份新工作。

sentences.en: She was busy, but more than that, the idea of a cruise across the sea gave her the creeps.
sentences.zh: 她很忙，但不仅如此，一想到要在海上乘船旅行，她就感到毛骨悚然。

sentences.en: She didn't really want to go.
sentences.zh: 她其实并不想去。

sentences.en: She would be just as happy settling into her new place.
sentences.zh: 她宁愿安心待在自己的新家里。

sentences.en: Which was nearby her parents' and brother's home in Chesterfield, Virginia.
sentences.zh: 新家就在她父母和弟弟位于弗吉尼亚州切斯特菲尔德的家附近。

sentences.en: Amy was really close with her younger brother Brad, who was 21.
sentences.zh: 埃米和她21岁的弟弟布拉德关系非常好。

sentences.en: And he and their parents, Ivor and Ron, were eventually able to talk Amy into joining them.
sentences.zh: 最终，布拉德以及他们的父母伊沃和罗恩说服了埃米和他们同行。

sentences.en: Ron had been given the trip by the insurance agency he worked for, and he believed it was a great chance to spend some quality time together.
sentences.zh: 这次旅行是罗恩工作的保险公司赠送的，他认为这是一个共度美好时光的好机会。

sentences.en: Seven days of sunshine, cruising the Caribbean, cocktails, and endless sunsets.
sentences.zh: 七天的阳光，畅游加勒比海，鸡尾酒，以及无尽的日落。

sentences.en: It wasn't long before Amy thought perhaps a cruise wouldn't be so bad after all.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，埃米觉得或许邮轮旅行其实也没那么糟。

sentences.en: It was starting to sound like the trip of a lifetime.
sentences.zh: 这开始听起来像是一生难忘的旅行。

sentences.en: Amy was born on May 12, 1974, and grew up with her family in the Creekwood subdivision in Chesterfield, Virginia.
sentences.zh: 埃米于1974年5月12日出生，在弗吉尼亚州切斯特菲尔德的克里克伍德分社区与家人一起长大。

sentences.en: She loved sports and excelled particularly in basketball and swimming.
sentences.zh: 她热爱体育，在篮球和游泳方面尤为擅长。

sentences.en: When it came time for college, she chose to study close to home and attended Longwood University.
sentences.zh: 到了上大学的时候，她选择在离家近的地方求学，就读于朗伍德大学。

sentences.en: She was a star basketball player, and at the time was the only student in the school's history to attend on a full athletic scholarship.
sentences.zh: 她是一名明星篮球运动员，当时是该校历史上唯一一名凭借全额体育奖学金入学的学生。

sentences.en: By the time she completed her degree in physical education, she was a trained lifeguard, a strong swimmer, and had a teaching certificate.
sentences.zh: 在她完成体育教育学位时，她已经是一名受过培训的救生员、游泳健将，并拥有教师资格证。

sentences.en: But despite those attributes, Amy couldn't help but feel nervous about going on a cruise.
sentences.zh: 但尽管拥有这些特质，埃米还是忍不住对乘坐游轮感到紧张。

sentences.en: It just didn't sit right with her.
sentences.zh: 她就是觉得哪里不对劲。

sentences.en: The day before they left for their cruise, Amy adopted an English bulldog puppy, which she named Daisy.
sentences.zh: 就在他们出发去游轮的前一天，埃米领养了一只英国斗牛犬幼犬，并给它取名叫黛西。

sentences.en: Daisy would be ready to pick up the day she got back from the cruise.
sentences.zh: 黛西将在她从游轮回来那天接回家。

sentences.en: The Bradleys flew to San Juan, Puerto Rico, where on Saturday, March 21st, 1998, the cruise would depart for seven nights.
sentences.zh: 布拉德利一家飞往波多黎各圣胡安，1998年3月21日星期六，游轮将在那里出发，开始为期七晚的航行。

sentences.en: They would cruise the waters of the Southern Caribbean to Aruba, Curacao, onto St. Martin, and back to Puerto Rico.
sentences.zh: 他们将乘船游览南加勒比海的水域，前往阿鲁巴、库拉索，接着到圣马丁，最后返回波多黎各。

sentences.en: The Royal Caribbean's Rhapsody of the Seas was a brand new luxury ship at the time, with its first voyage less than a year earlier.
sentences.zh: 皇家加勒比海游轮公司的“海洋旋律号”在当时是一艘全新的豪华巨轮，其处女航还不到一年。

sentences.en: It was owned and operated by Royal Caribbean Cruise Lines of Miami, Florida.
sentences.zh: 它由总部位于佛罗里达州迈阿密的皇家加勒比游轮公司拥有和运营。

sentences.en: And although it has been registered in the Bahamas since 2005, back in 1998, it was registered in Norway.
sentences.zh: 尽管它自2005年起在巴哈马注册，但在1998年，它是在挪威注册的。

sentences.en: At 280 metres long, the ship carried close to 2,000 passengers and over 700 crew, with Norwegian officers and crew members from over 50 nationalities.
sentences.zh: 这艘船长280米，搭载了近2000名乘客和700多名船员，其中包含挪威籍军官以及来自50多个国家的船员。

sentences.en: Like many cruises, the itinerary was a mix of days docking at port for day trips, as well as days cruising the sea, passing islands,
sentences.zh: 像许多游轮一样，行程安排结合了停靠港口进行日间游览的日子，以及在海面上巡航、驶过各个岛屿的日子，

sentences.en: and watching the sunset in a new place each evening.
sentences.zh: 并在每天傍晚在不同的地方欣赏日落。

sentences.en: Itineraries were planned with formal dinners and casual meet and greets.
sentences.zh: 行程中既有正式晚宴，也有休闲见面会。

sentences.en: The cruise experience was enhanced by personal service.
sentences.zh: 个性化服务提升了游轮体验。

sentences.en: Crew members are encouraged to be friendly with passengers, many addressing them by name.
sentences.zh: 船员被鼓励对乘客友好，许多人甚至能直呼乘客的名字。

sentences.en: The allure of cruising has been at the heart of American vacations for decades, with TV shows like The Love Boat painting a picture of luxury, fun, and adventure.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，邮轮旅行的魅力一直是美国人度假的核心，诸如《爱之船》之类的电视节目描绘了一幅奢华、快乐和冒险的画卷。

sentences.en: The 80s and 90s saw the cruise industry become the fastest-growing category in the leisure travel market, continuing to consistently grow approximately 7% per annum since 1980.
sentences.zh: 80和90年代见证了邮轮产业成为休闲旅游市场中增长最快的类别，自1980年以来，该产业一直保持着每年约7%的稳健增长。

sentences.en: Cruisers are a loyal type of vacationer, with many returning year after year.
sentences.zh: 邮轮游客是忠诚的度假群体，许多人年复一年地重返游轮。

sentences.en: Passengers are drawn to the fun and party atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 乘客们被欢乐和派对的氛围所吸引。

sentences.en: In 1998, the cruisers of the Caribbean were the most sought-after voyage, and now, almost 20 years on, 34% of all cruisers worldwide are on the Caribbean and Bahamas routes.
sentences.zh: 在1998年，加勒比海游轮是最抢手的航线，而现在，将近20年过去了，全球所有邮轮游客中有34%都在加勒比海和巴哈马航线上。

sentences.en: When it came to travelling in style and luxury close to American soil, people loved the idea of days-wandering exotic places, crystal blue waters, clear skies, and quaint,
sentences.zh: 说到在美国本土附近享受时尚与奢华的旅行，人们热爱这种体验：漫步于异国风情之地数日，清澈蔚蓝的海水，晴朗的天空，以及古朴、

sentences.en: charming tropical islands.
sentences.zh: 迷人的热带岛屿。

sentences.en: It gave them a taste of the island life, without having to stay on the islands themselves, as they could return to their luxury cabin on what was essentially a floating city.
sentences.zh: 这让他们足不出岛就能体验岛屿生活，因为他们可以回到本质上就是一座漂浮城市的豪华客舱中。

sentences.en: In 1998, few people questioned how things were run aboard luxury cruisers.
sentences.zh: 在1998年，很少有人质疑豪华游轮上的运作方式。

sentences.en: Most passengers received information from their travel agents, and then read the brochures listing all the perks and offers available to them.
sentences.zh: 大多数乘客从旅行社获取信息，然后阅读列出所有福利和优惠的宣传册。

sentences.en: Although there have been some changes made now, in 1998, the US government had no jurisdiction over cruise ships.
sentences.zh: 尽管现在有了一些变化，但在1998年，美国政府对游轮没有管辖权。

sentences.en: Governed by century-old maritime laws, if something went wrong aboard an international cruise on international waters, US passengers were not protected by any US laws.
sentences.zh: 受制于拥有百年历史的海事法，如果国际游轮在国际水域发生意外，美国乘客将不受任何美国法律的保护。

sentences.en: Instead, they were governed by the laws of the country of the ship's registry, and or the laws of the country of the port of call.
sentences.zh: 相反，他们受船舶注册国法律和/或停靠港国家法律的管辖。

sentences.en: Even the FBI often had their hands tied.
sentences.zh: 甚至联邦调查局也常常束手无策。

sentences.en: Many passengers who went on luxury cruisers at the time believed they were boarding an extension of their own country,
sentences.zh: 当年许多乘坐豪华游轮的乘客认为他们登上一自己国家的延伸领土，

sentences.en: especially in the case of Americans boarding ships like the Rhapsody of the Seas, where the cruise company was based in Florida.
sentences.zh: 特别是美国人登上像“海洋旋律号”这样总部设在佛罗里达的游轮公司的船只时更是如此。

sentences.en: But with offshore registration and ancient laws of the high seas, they were actually entering an almost lawless floating city,
sentences.zh: 但由于离岸注册和古老的高海公海法律，他们实际上进入了一座几乎无法无天的漂浮城市，

sentences.en: with regulations specific to countries many passengers had never been to, and knew very little about.
sentences.zh: 这里的规章制度针对的是许多乘客从未去过且知之甚少的国家。

sentences.en: And the tropical paradises that awaited them had their own dark and secret underbelly not advertised in the glossy brochures.
sentences.zh: 等待他们的热带天堂有着精美的宣传册上未曾提及的黑暗与秘密内幕。

sentences.en: Many destinations were rife with illegal trading of drugs, money, sex, and people.
sentences.zh: 许多目的地充斥着毒品、金钱、性与人口的非法交易。

sentences.en: Islands of great unknown.
sentences.zh: 充满巨大未知的岛屿。

sentences.en: The Bradleys travelled to Puerto Rico to board the Rhapsody of the Seas on Saturday, March 21st, 1998.
sentences.zh: 1998年3月21日星期六，布拉德利一家前往波多黎各登上“海洋旋律号”。

sentences.en: Prior to boarding, Amy sent some postcards to friends.
sentences.zh: 登船前，埃米给朋友们寄了一些明信片。

sentences.en: In one, she wrote,
sentences.zh: 其中一张她写道：

sentences.en: Hey girl, it's gorgeous here.
sentences.zh: 嘿，女孩，这里美极了。

sentences.en: We leave for Aruba tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我们明天出发去阿鲁巴。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: Tell Madison and Niles hello.
sentences.zh: 代我向麦迪逊和奈尔斯问好。

sentences.en: I'll be home Saturday at 10.
sentences.zh: 我周六10点到家。

sentences.en: See ya, Amy.
sentences.zh: 回头见，埃米。

sentences.en: On another, she wrote,
sentences.zh: 在另一张上，她写道：

sentences.en: Hey, it's beautiful here.
sentences.zh: 嘿，这里太漂亮了。

sentences.en: Old San Juan has got some amazing buildings.
sentences.zh: 老圣胡安有一些令人惊叹的建筑。

sentences.en: I am taking pictures.
sentences.zh: 我正在拍照。

sentences.en: Maybe you can see them at Easter.
sentences.zh: 也许你能在复活节看到它们。

sentences.en: Wish you were here.
sentences.zh: 希望你也能来。

sentences.en: Amy.
sentences.zh: 埃米。

sentences.en: Seeing the new ship in the blazing sunshine, crew rushing around, and thousands of passengers ready to board, gave a nervous passenger like Amy comfort.
sentences.zh: 在灿烂的阳光下看到这艘崭新的巨轮，船员们忙碌穿梭，成千上万的乘客准备登船，这给像埃米这样容易紧张的乘客带来了一丝安慰。

sentences.en: The excitement of other passengers was infectious.
sentences.zh: 其他乘客的兴奋之情具有感染力。

sentences.en: It was an exciting experience approaching a large ship about to hit the open sea, and the sheer size of the Rhapsody was a comfort itself.
sentences.zh: 走近一艘即将驶向公海的大型船只是一种令人兴奋的体验，“海洋旋律号”庞大的体量本身就是一种慰藉。

sentences.en: It felt safer than Amy expected, and she started to relax.
sentences.zh: 它比埃米预期的要安全，她开始放松下来。

sentences.en: Everyone received their onboard cruise cards and room keys.
sentences.zh: 每个人都领到了他们的船上消费卡和房间钥匙。

sentences.en: As Amy and her family prepared to walk the gangway onto the cruise, they had their photo taken to remember the special occasion.
sentences.zh: 当埃米和家人准备走过舷梯登上游轮时，他们拍了张照片来纪念这个特殊的时刻。

sentences.en: It was set to be a memorable week, and with check-in over, the Bradleys boarded the Rhapsody of the Seas, a moment they would never forget.
sentences.zh: 这将是难忘的一周，随着登船手续完成，布拉德利一家登上了“海洋旋律号”，这是一个他们永远不会忘记的时刻。

sentences.en: As Amy's mother, Ivor, looked at her family, she thought how special that moment was.
sentences.zh: 当埃米的母亲伊沃看着自己的家人时，她觉得这个时刻是多么特别。

sentences.en: The Bradleys were given a junior suite on Deck 8, cabin number 8564, which was halfway down on the starboard side of the ship, close to the elevators.
sentences.zh: 布拉德利一家被分配到8层的一个初级套房，客房号是8564，位于船的右舷中部，靠近电梯。

sentences.en: They were all together in the same room.
sentences.zh: 他们都住在一个房间里。

sentences.en: They had their own private balcony where they could sit and enjoy the view, and their room had floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors, so Ron and Ivor could see out from their bed.
sentences.zh: 他们有自己的私人阳台，可以坐在那里欣赏风景，他们的房间还有落地推拉玻璃门，罗恩和伊沃从床上就能看到外面的景色。

sentences.en: There were twin beds for Amy and Brad, and all the other amenities of a hotel suite.
sentences.zh: 房间里有供埃米和布拉德住的双床，以及酒店套房的所有其他设施。

sentences.en: Amy unpacked her bags, including nine pairs of shoes and 15 rolls of film.
sentences.zh: 埃米打开了行李，其中包括九双鞋和15卷胶卷。

sentences.en: She planned to take plenty of pictures to make a collage for a coffee table for her new apartment.
sentences.zh: 她计划拍大量的照片，为新公寓的咖啡桌做一个拼贴画。

sentences.en: As they departed, dark shadows formed over the forts of Puerto Rico right alongside the ship, and as the sun set, they left the twinkling lights of the city behind them.
sentences.zh: 当他们启程时，黑色的阴影顺着船身笼罩了波多黎各的堡垒，随着太阳下山，他们将城市闪烁的灯光抛在了身后。

sentences.en: The first nights before the cruise docked in Aruba, the Bradleys enjoyed everything promised by the Rhapsody.
sentences.zh: 在游轮停靠阿鲁巴之前的那几个夜晚，布拉德利一家尽情享受了“海洋旋律号”承诺的一切。

sentences.en: There was a formal dinner where Amy and Brad posed for a photograph taken by the ship's resident photographer.
sentences.zh: 船上举行了一场正式晚宴，埃米和布拉德在那里摆好姿势，由船上的专属摄影师为他们拍了张照。

sentences.en: Ron had other insurance colleagues on the ship who they caught up with, and everyone talked excitedly about the places they were heading to.
sentences.zh: 罗恩在船上遇到了同行的其他保险业同事，大家都兴奋地谈论着他们即将前往的地方。

sentences.en: Three waiters who were stationed at the Bradleys' table began to flirt with Amy.
sentences.zh: 负责布拉德利一家餐桌的三名服务员开始向埃米献殷勤。

sentences.en: Ivor thought it was a bit forward, but she was happy that her daughter was getting attention.
sentences.zh: 伊沃觉得这有点过于主动了，但她很高兴女儿受到关注。

sentences.en: Ivor, quote,
sentences.zh: 伊沃原话如下：

sentences.en: After dinner one evening, one of the waiters approached us and asked for Amy by name.
sentences.zh: 一天晚上晚餐后，其中一名服务员走近我们，指名要找埃米。

sentences.en: The waiter stated they wanted to take Amy to a bar, Carlos and Charlie's, while docked in Aruba.
sentences.zh: 服务员说他们想带埃米去阿鲁巴停靠期间的一家酒吧——卡洛斯和查理酒吧。

sentences.en: When Amy and Brad met with us a short time later, we told Amy about the waiter who had asked for her by name.
sentences.zh: 不久后，当埃米和布拉德与我们会合时，我们把那个指名找她的服务员的事告诉了埃米。

sentences.en: She responded,
sentences.zh: 她回答说：

sentences.en: I wouldn't go and do anything with any of those crew members.
sentences.zh: 我才不会跟那些船员一起出去做任何事呢。

sentences.en: They give me the creeps.
sentences.zh: 他们让我感到毛骨悚然。

sentences.en: Carlos and Charlie's was a hotspot for partying for cruise crew members and holidaymakers.
sentences.zh: 卡洛斯和查理酒吧是游轮船员和度假者聚会的热门地点。

sentences.en: This is the same location where, seven years later, 18-year-old Natalie Holloway would disappear while on a school graduation trip.
sentences.zh: 正是这个地方，在七年后，18岁的娜塔莉·霍洛威在参加学校毕业旅行时离奇失踪。

sentences.en: When the ship docked in Aruba the following morning, the Bradleys disembarked together and posed for a family photo on the gangway with the ship in the background.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上游轮停靠阿鲁巴时，布拉德利一家一同下船，并在以游轮为背景的舷梯上合影留念。

sentences.en: Everyone was relaxed, and all were looking forward to a day of shopping and sightseeing.
sentences.zh: 大家都放松下来，期盼着购物和观光的一天。

sentences.en: They rented a jeep to tour the island, and Amy bought some gifts for her friends to take back home.
sentences.zh: 他们租了一辆吉普车环岛游览，埃米还买了一些带回家的礼物送给朋友。

sentences.en: As the day drew in, they returned to the cruise terminal to re-board the ship.
sentences.zh: 随着夜幕降临，他们返回游轮码头重新登船。

sentences.en: That evening, there was a Calypso dinner party on board the Rhapsody of the Seas.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，“海洋旋律号”上举行了加勒比风情晚宴派对。

sentences.en: The Bradleys had enjoyed their day off the boat in Aruba, but were looking forward to a relaxing evening and some fun entertainment.
sentences.zh: 布拉德利一家很享受在阿鲁巴下船的那天，但也很期待一个轻松的夜晚和有趣的娱乐活动。

sentences.en: Amy and Brad had no intention of going partying with the crew members off the ship in Aruba.
sentences.zh: 埃米和布拉德根本没打算在阿鲁巴和下船的船员去参加派对。

sentences.en: They were happy just to stay together on board.
sentences.zh: 他们只想一起留在船上。

sentences.en: Later that night, the ship would leave Aruba for the island of Curacao, which at the time was a small island territory of the former Netherlands Antilles,
sentences.zh: 那天晚些时候，游轮将离开阿鲁巴前往库拉索岛，该岛当时是前荷属安的列斯群岛的一个小岛屿领地，

sentences.en: another top destination of the cruise circuit, and only 70 miles east of Aruba.
sentences.zh: 也是游轮航线的另一个顶级目的地，距离阿鲁巴仅70英里以东。

sentences.en: They got ready and headed up to the upper deck where the house band was entertaining guests.
sentences.zh: 他们换好衣服，前往顶层甲板，那里有驻场乐队在为客人们助兴。

sentences.en: A dance troupe had boarded the ship in Aruba temporarily to perform, and with them they brought a group of locals who were standing alongside the ship's railing.
sentences.zh: 一个舞蹈团在阿鲁巴临时登船进行表演，随他们一起来的还有一群当地人，正站在船的栏杆旁。

sentences.en: The Bradleys weren't the only passengers to notice the group.
sentences.zh: 布拉德利一家并不是唯一注意到这群人的乘客。

sentences.en: It seemed a bit weird to them.
sentences.zh: 这让他们觉得有点诡异。

sentences.en: They weren't paying guests, and they weren't there to perform themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们不是买票的乘客，自己也不是来表演的。

sentences.en: Ivor, quote,
sentences.zh: 伊沃原话如下：

sentences.en: How could they be allowed to board a ship and just stand around watching the performance with paying passengers?
sentences.zh: 他们怎么被允许登上一艘船，然后就站在那里和买票的乘客一起看表演？

sentences.en: During the party, Amy and Ivor went to the fourth deck to look at the photos that had been taken after dinner that evening, as well as the evening before.
sentences.zh: 派对期间，埃米和伊沃去了四楼，查看那天晚上以及前一天晚上晚餐后拍的照片。

sentences.en: Like all cruisers, there were boards set up where passengers' photos were displayed.
sentences.zh: 就像所有游轮一样，那里设立了展示乘客照片的展板。

sentences.en: Every table had group dinner shots taken, and the photographer had also taken other photos around the ship.
sentences.zh: 每张桌子都拍了晚宴合影，摄影师还在船上其他地方拍了照片。

sentences.en: The photos were then put up on display for sale.
sentences.zh: 这些照片随后被摆出来供人购买。

sentences.en: Ivor, quote,
sentences.zh: 伊沃原话如下：

sentences.en: We asked the person in charge of the gallery where Amy's pictures would be posted.
sentences.zh: 我们问了画廊负责人埃米的照片会贴在哪里。

sentences.en: He said he remembered placing them with the other photos taken at the same time, but acknowledged he couldn't find them either.
sentences.zh: 他说他记得把它们和其他同时拍摄的照片放在一起，但承认他也找不到。

sentences.en: I asked him if he could have them redeveloped, and he agreed, claiming they would be available the next day.
sentences.zh: 我问他能不能重新冲洗，他答应了，并称第二天就能取。

sentences.en: Ivor walked away wondering why anyone else on board the ship from outside their family would want to take the photos of Amy.
sentences.zh: 伊沃一边走开，一边纳闷船上除了他们家人之外，为什么还会有别人想拿埃米的照片。

sentences.en: The Calypso party continued on, and Amy and Brad won a limbo conteSt.
sentences.zh: 加勒比派对继续进行，埃米和布拉德赢得了一场 limbo（林波舞）比赛。

sentences.en: During the evening, Amy met the bassist from the ship's band, Blue Orchid.
sentences.zh: 当晚，埃米结识了船上乐队“蓝色兰花”的贝斯手。

sentences.en: The bassist, Alistair Douglas, also known as Yellow, had taken particular interest in her, and they enjoyed a few drinks together after the band finished playing.
sentences.zh: 这名贝斯手名叫阿利斯泰尔·道格拉斯，也被称为“黄色”，他对她表现出了特别的兴趣，乐队演奏结束后，他们在一起喝了几杯。

sentences.en: They danced together with a large group of other guests and some of the crew.
sentences.zh: 他们和一大群其他客人以及一些船员一起跳舞。

sentences.en: At 1.30am on March 24, Ivor and Ron retired to their family suite on the 8th deck, leaving Amy and Brad dancing at the Calypso party.
sentences.zh: 3月24日凌晨1点30分，伊沃和罗恩退回了位于8层的家庭套房，留下埃米和布拉德在加勒比派对上跳舞。

sentences.en: After the party, Amy and Brad continued on at the nightclub.
sentences.zh: 派对结束后，埃米和布拉德继续留在夜总会。

sentences.en: Amy and Yellow were slow dancing on the dance floor at 3am.
sentences.zh: 凌晨3点，埃米和“黄色”正在舞池里跳慢舞。

sentences.en: Brad left back for the cabin just before 3.30, and a few minutes later, Amy was seen approaching the lift at the side of the dance floor, alone.
sentences.zh: 布拉德在将近3点30分时返回了客舱，几分钟后，有人看到埃米独自一人走向舞池旁的电梯。

sentences.en: The nightclub had around 30 to 40 people still dancing by the time Amy left.
sentences.zh: 埃米离开时，夜总会里大约还有30到40人在跳舞。

sentences.en: The ship's computerised door lock system recorded Brad's return to the suite at 3.35.
sentences.zh: 船上的电脑门锁系统记录了布拉德在3点35分返回套房的时间。

sentences.en: Amy's arrival was 5 minutes later.
sentences.zh: 埃米在5分钟后到达。

sentences.en: Ivor and Ron were asleep, so Brad and Amy sat on the balcony and chatted for a little while.
sentences.zh: 伊沃和罗恩已经睡着了，所以布拉德和埃米坐在阳台上聊了一会儿。

sentences.en: Brad started to fall asleep, so he went inside the bed.
sentences.zh: 布拉德开始犯困，于是他回屋上床睡觉了。

sentences.en: Amy stretched out on a lounge chair on the balcony and fell asleep there.
sentences.zh: 埃米则在阳台的躺椅上伸展开身子，并在那里睡着了。

sentences.en: Around 5.30am, Ron woke up.
sentences.zh: 清晨5点30分左右，罗恩醒了过来。

sentences.en: As he looked outside from his bed, he saw Amy's legs on the lounge chair.
sentences.zh: 当他从床上向外看时，他看到了躺椅上埃米的双腿。

sentences.en: He couldn't see her face, but assumed because she was so still, she was asleep.
sentences.zh: 他看不到她的脸，但猜想因为她一动不动，所以应该是睡着了。

sentences.en: Amy's cigarettes and lighter lay on the deck next to her chair, and the sliding glass door was closed.
sentences.zh: 埃米的香烟和打火机放在她椅子旁边的甲板上，推拉玻璃门是关着的。

sentences.en: He thought it best just to leave her.
sentences.zh: 他觉得最好还是由她去吧。

sentences.en: Amy and Brad had had a big night, and it wasn't long before they would have to wake up.
sentences.zh: 埃米和布拉德昨晚玩得很晚，没过多久他们就得醒来。

sentences.en: The ship was already heading towards port at Curacao, and after an early breakfast, the ship would dock.
sentences.zh: 船已经驶向库拉索港口，吃过早饭后，船就会靠岸。

sentences.en: Ron dozed a little more himself.
sentences.zh: 罗恩自己又打了一会儿盹。

sentences.en: Just before 6am, Ron thinks he may have heard their cabin door quietly close.
sentences.zh: 早上6点前不久，罗恩觉得他好像听到他们的舱门轻轻关上了。

sentences.en: At 6am, Ron woke up and saw that Amy wasn't on the balcony, and the sliding glass door was now ajar, about 16 inches.
sentences.zh: 早上6点，罗恩醒来，发现埃米不在阳台上，而那扇推拉玻璃门现在正虚掩着，大约有16英寸开缝。

sentences.en: He looked around a little and saw that her shoes were still out on the balcony, but her cigarettes and lighter were gone.
sentences.zh: 他四处看了看，发现她的鞋子还放在阳台上，但她的烟和打火机不见了。

sentences.en: She was nowhere in the cabin, so he thought that she must have gone up to one of the decks to have a cigarette and watch the ship come into port.
sentences.zh: 客舱里到处都找不到她，于是他想她一定是去甲板上抽烟并看船进港了。

sentences.en: He thought it was a bit strange that she hadn't taken her shoes, but perhaps she had only popped out for a moment.
sentences.zh: 他觉得她没穿鞋有点奇怪，但也许她只是出去一会儿。

sentences.en: Ron got dressed and headed out to look for her.
sentences.zh: 罗恩穿好衣服，出门去找她。

sentences.en: By the time he got to the upper decks, the cruise ship was approaching the dock.
sentences.zh: 等他走到上层甲板时，游轮已经快要靠岸了。

sentences.en: After looking around the open areas of the ship and finding no sign of Amy, Ron's concern turned into panic.
sentences.zh: 罗恩在船上的开阔区域找了一圈，也没看到埃米的影子，他的担忧转变成了恐慌。

sentences.en: He didn't have a good feeling.
sentences.zh: 他有一种很不好的预感。

sentences.en: On his way back to the cabin, Ron ran into the ship's security chief, Lou Costello.
sentences.zh: 在回客舱的路上，罗恩遇到了船上的保安主管卢·科斯特洛。

sentences.en: He told Costello he was unable to find his daughter, and he asked him if he would look out for her.
sentences.zh: 他告诉科斯特洛他找不到女儿了，并请他帮忙留意一下。

sentences.en: To the security chief of a 2,000-person cruise ship, a 23-year-old who left her cabin with a packet of cigarettes less than an hour before, was not a great concern.
sentences.zh: 对于一艘载有2000名乘客的游轮的保安主管来说，一个不到一小时前带着一包烟离开客舱的23岁女孩，并不算什么大不了的事。

sentences.en: Costello believed Amy was likely standing somewhere watching the view of the island as they drew nearer.
sentences.zh: 科斯特洛认为，埃米很可能是站在某处欣赏越来越近的岛屿风光。

sentences.en: With 35 beaches on such a small island, the view was a memorable one, and many passengers often lined the rails to watch.
sentences.zh: 这么小的岛上有35处海滩，景色令人难忘，许多乘客经常排在栏杆旁观看。

sentences.en: Just before 7am, Ron went back to the cabin and woke up Ivor and Brad.
sentences.zh: 早上7点前不久，罗恩回到客舱，叫醒了艾沃和布拉德。

sentences.en: Ivor said that from the moment she saw her husband's face, she knew that something terrible was going on.
sentences.zh: 艾沃说，从看到丈夫脸的那一刻起，她就知道发生了可怕的事情。

sentences.en: He was frantic, and in turn, that made Ivor panic.
sentences.zh: 他急疯了，这反过来也让艾沃陷入了恐慌。

sentences.en: The Bradleys left their cabin and walked the entire length of the ship, deck by deck.
sentences.zh: 布拉德利一家离开客舱，一层甲板接一层甲板地走遍了整艘船。

sentences.en: Passengers were busy getting off the ship and onto the island.
sentences.zh: 乘客们正忙着下船上岛。

sentences.en: Ron and Ivor went to the captain and requested he make an announcement over the speaker system for Amy.
sentences.zh: 罗恩和艾沃找到船长，请求他在广播系统里播音寻找埃米。

sentences.en: The captain refused.
sentences.zh: 船长拒绝了。

sentences.en: He said it was too early in the morning to use loudspeakers.
sentences.zh: 他说一大清早用喇叭播音太早了。

sentences.en: The Bradleys requested that the gangways be secured to stop letting people off the cruise until they found Amy.
sentences.zh: 布拉德利一家请求固定好舷梯，在找到埃米之前停止放人下邮轮。

sentences.en: They were worried that if someone had her, they may carry her off the ship.
sentences.zh: 他们担心如果有人抓了她，可能会把她带下船。

sentences.en: The captain refused.
sentences.zh: 船长拒绝了。

sentences.en: They requested that they post a picture up of Amy, but again, the captain refused.
sentences.zh: 他们请求张贴一张埃米的照片，但船长再次拒绝了。

sentences.en: The captain remained adamant that any announcement or formal search would disturb the passengers.
sentences.zh: 船长态度坚决，认为任何广播或正式搜查都会打扰乘客。

sentences.en: It was now 8am, and Ron had been looking for Amy for almost two hours.
sentences.zh: 现在已经是早上8点，罗恩找了埃米快两个小时了。

sentences.en: After more pleading, some of the ship's officers finally agreed to make an announcement, but not that she was missing.
sentences.zh: 经过再三恳求，一些船上官员终于同意广播一次，但不是播报她失踪的消息。

sentences.en: The message simply said,
sentences.zh: 这条广播只是说，

sentences.en: Amy Bradley, please contact the purser's desk.
sentences.zh: 埃米·布拉德利，请与乘务长办公室联系。

sentences.en: The Bradleys were frantic.
sentences.zh: 布拉德利一家急疯了。

sentences.en: The cruise personnel kept telling them that Amy must have gone ashore.
sentences.zh: 邮轮工作人员一直告诉他们，埃米肯定是上岸去了。

sentences.en: Ivor, quote,
sentences.zh: 艾沃原话如下，

sentences.en: Amy would just never think of going ashore or to some secluded part of the ship without telling us, because she knows how we'd worry.
sentences.zh: 埃米绝不可能在不告诉我们的情况下擅自上岸或去船上某个偏僻的地方，因为她知道我们会多么担心。

sentences.en: The Bradleys continued to search everywhere, and the security chief, Lou Costello, and the captain told them that they were conducting a thorough search themselves.
sentences.zh: 布拉德利一家继续到处搜寻，保安主管卢·科斯特洛和船长告诉他们，他们自己也在进行彻底的搜查。

sentences.en: While searching an internal deck, Brad ran into Yellow, the bass player from the ship's bands who Amy was dancing with the night before.
sentences.zh: 在搜查内部甲板时，布拉德遇到了“黄色”，也就是埃米昨晚跳过舞的船上乐队的贝斯手。

sentences.en: Yellow said he was sorry to hear about Amy, but he didn't offer to help look for her.
sentences.zh: “黄色”说很遗憾听到埃米的事，但他并没有主动提出帮忙寻找。

sentences.en: By lunchtime, the Bradleys were literally begging the captain to make an announcement that Amy was missing.
sentences.zh: 到了午饭时间，布拉德利一家简直是在哀求船长广播宣布埃米失踪。

sentences.en: Ivor, quote,
sentences.zh: 艾沃原话如下，

sentences.en: Around lunchtime, again the captain of the cruise ship told us that he would not make an announcement that she was missing,
sentences.zh: 大约在午饭时间，游轮船长再次告诉我们，他不会广播宣布她失踪，

sentences.en: or post a photo for other passengers to view, as this would alarm the other guests, and he was not prepared to do that.
sentences.zh: 也不会张贴照片供其他乘客查看，因为这会惊动其他客人，他不愿意这么做。

sentences.en: He told us that every nook and cranny of the ship had been searched for Amy, all 10 decks, and 999 rooMs.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我们，船上的每个角落都为了埃米搜查过了，所有的10层甲板和999间客房。

sentences.en: There was no sign of Amy Lynn Bradley anywhere.
sentences.zh: 到处都找不到埃米·琳·布拉德利的踪影。

sentences.en: It was then that the captain made the comment that Amy may have fallen overboard, but the Bradleys weren't having it.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，船长提出了一种看法，即埃米可能不小心落水了，但布拉德利一家根本不信。

sentences.en: In order for her to fall, she would have had to have been climbing, or flung in rough seas.
sentences.zh: 要想掉下去，她要么得去爬栏杆，要么就是在惊涛骇浪中被甩出去。

sentences.en: The sea was calm that morning, and the Bradleys were adamant that there was no way Amy would climb the railings.
sentences.zh: 那天早上的海面风平浪静，布拉德利一家坚信埃米绝不可能去爬栏杆。

sentences.en: She was nervous enough about stepping on the boat.
sentences.zh: 她对踏上这艘船已经够紧张的了。

sentences.en: They also knew that the railings were designed so that people didn't just stumble over them, even after a night of drinking.
sentences.zh: 他们也知道栏杆的设计就是为了防止人们不小心绊倒摔过去，即使在喝了酒的晚上也是如此。

sentences.en: The railing on their balcony also had a shelf below it, so Amy falling overboard didn't make any sense to them.
sentences.zh: 他们阳台的栏杆下面还有一个平台，所以埃米落水对他们来说根本说不通。

sentences.en: But the captain felt it was a possibility, and he contacted the US Coast Guard to organise a sea search.
sentences.zh: 但船长觉得有这种可能，于是他联系了美国海岸警卫队组织海上搜救。

sentences.en: It was at this time that a member of the crew suggested that the Bradleys disembark and search for Amy in Curacao.
sentences.zh: 正是在这个时候，一名船员建议布拉德利一家下船，在库拉索寻找埃米。

sentences.en: As the Bradleys had already done a thorough search of the ship, they felt this was a good idea, and they prepared to disembark.
sentences.zh: 既然布拉德利一家已经在船上进行了彻底搜查，他们觉得这是个好主意，并准备下船。

sentences.en: The cruise terminal at the pier in Curacao is an open area.
sentences.zh: 库拉索码头的游轮客运站是一个开阔的区域。

sentences.en: Thousands of passengers disembark and go through the formalities of customs, and are then free to go.
sentences.zh: 数千名乘客下船并办完海关手续后，就可以自由活动了。

sentences.en: While the ship is docked, staff come and go, and laundry carts and garbage bins are regularly willed past customs officials by crew members.
sentences.zh: 当船靠岸时，工作人员进进出出，洗衣车和垃圾桶经常由船员推着从海关官员身边经过。

sentences.en: In 1998, regulations were not as strict as in the years that followed 9-11.
sentences.zh: 在1998年，规章制度远不像“9·11”之后几年那么严格。

sentences.en: It was highly possible that someone could travel or be moved through the customs area without being checked.
sentences.zh: 很有可能有人未经检查就能通过海关区域旅行或被转移。

sentences.en: When Ron, Ivor and Brad got off the ship, they immediately contacted the Curacao authorities and the US Embassy for help.
sentences.zh: 当罗恩、艾沃和布拉德下船后，他们立即联系了库拉索当局和美国大使馆寻求帮助。

sentences.en: They were soon in touch with the FBI, but they were told that investigators would not be able to get there for 24 hours.
sentences.zh: 他们很快与联邦调查局取得了联系，但被告知调查人员需要24小时才能赶到。

sentences.en: They were completely loSt.
sentences.zh: 他们彻底迷茫了。

sentences.en: They didn't know where to look or how to ask anyone for help.
sentences.zh: 他们不知道该去哪里找，也不知道该怎么向任何人寻求帮助。

sentences.en: They walked the streets and beaches, but there was no sign of Amy anywhere on the island.
sentences.zh: 他们走过街道和海滩，但在岛上的任何地方都找不到埃米的踪迹。

sentences.en: The Bradleys then had to decide whether they would get back on board the Rhapsody of the Seas and head on to the next destination,
sentences.zh: 布拉德利一家随后必须做出决定，是重新登上“海洋狂想曲号”继续前往下一站，

sentences.en: St. Martin, or stay in Curacao and keep searching for Amy while waiting for the FBI.
sentences.zh: 圣马丁，还是留在库拉索继续寻找埃米并等待联邦调查局。

sentences.en: In the end, they decided to stay in Curacao.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们决定留在库拉索。

sentences.en: They watched as the Rhapsody of the Seas pulled out of port.
sentences.zh: 他们看着“海洋狂想曲号”驶离港口。

sentences.en: At the time Amy Lynn Bradley disappeared, she was 5 feet 7 inches tall, weighed 120 pounds, and had short brown hair and green eyes.
sentences.zh: 埃米·琳·布拉德利失踪时，身高5英尺7英寸（约1.7米），体重120磅（约54公斤），留着短棕发，长着绿眼睛。

sentences.en: She had a Tasmanian devil cartoon with a basketball tattooed on her left shoulder blade, a Chinese symbol tattooed on her right ankle,
sentences.zh: 她的左肩胛骨上有一个拿着篮球的塔斯马尼亚恶魔卡通纹身，右脚踝上有一个汉字纹身，

sentences.en: Curacao was, and still is, one of the most anticipated destinations on any Caribbean cruise.
sentences.zh: 库拉索过去是，现在仍然是任何加勒比海游轮中最令人期待的目的地之一。

sentences.en: The island is small and built up with quaint, colourful, Dutch-style architecture.
sentences.zh: 这个岛屿很小，建筑风格古朴多彩，带有荷兰特色。

sentences.en: It's a sought-after spot for divers and snorkelers, with around 60 dive sites surrounding the island.
sentences.zh: 它是潜水和浮潜爱好者的热门去处，岛屿周围有大约60个潜水点。

sentences.en: It's known for its relaxed and fun atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 它以轻松愉快的氛围而闻名。

sentences.en: But there is a dark side.
sentences.zh: 但这里也有黑暗的一面。

sentences.en: The busy tourist market, the constant comings and goings of aircraft, cruise ships, crews and tourists, provided an infrastructure in which illegal activity flourished.
sentences.zh: 繁忙的旅游市场、飞机、游轮、船员和游客的频繁进出，为非法活动的滋生提供了温床。

sentences.en: Drug trafficking and money laundering mainly.
sentences.zh: 主要是毒品贩运和洗钱。

sentences.en: At the time of Amy's disappearance,
sentences.zh: 在埃米失踪的时候，

sentences.en: US officials estimated that 40% of all drugs reaching the US mainland passed through the Caribbean.
sentences.zh: 美国官员估计，所有进入美国本土的毒品中，有40%是通过加勒比地区运送的。

sentences.en: That figure was four times what it had been a decade earlier.
sentences.zh: 这个数字是十年前的四倍。

sentences.en: The 90s were a very busy time for illegal activity in the Caribbean, and a very busy time for tourism, including sex tourism.
sentences.zh: 20世纪90年代是加勒比地区非法活动极其猖獗的时期，也是包括性旅游在内的旅游业高度繁荣的时期。

sentences.en: On the majority of the Caribbean islands, sex work is illegal.
sentences.zh: 在大多数加勒比岛屿上，性工作都是非法的。

sentences.en: But the Dutch Antilles provided a unique opportunity for the sex industry not legally available in the rest of the Caribbean.
sentences.zh: 但荷属安的列斯群岛为性产业提供了一个加勒比其他地区在法律上不具备的独家机会。

sentences.en: According to Alea Walker, a researcher for the Council on Hemispheric Affairs, quote,
sentences.zh: 根据西半球事务委员会的研究员阿利娅·沃克所说，

sentences.en: As present or former territories of the Netherlands, the Dutch Antilles fall under many of the same general laws as their mother country,
sentences.zh: 作为荷兰的现属或前属领地，荷属安的列斯群岛受许多与其母国相同的法律管辖，

sentences.en: including the controlled legalisation of sex work on the six Dutch-speaking islands.
sentences.zh: 包括在六个讲荷兰语的岛屿上有控制地将性工作合法化。

sentences.en: Being regulated arguably makes the work safer than other Caribbean locations.
sentences.zh: 可以说，受到监管使得这项工作比在加勒比其他地方更安全。

sentences.en: Sint Maarten and Curacao are particularly prime locations for sex tourism, as they house the two largest brothels in the Dutch Caribbean.
sentences.zh: 圣马丁岛和库拉索岛是性旅游的绝佳地点，因为这里拥有荷属加勒比地区最大的两家妓院。

sentences.en: The largest, Campo Allegri, is located on Curacao, while the smaller Seaman's Club is located on Sint Maarten.
sentences.zh: 其中最大的“坎波·阿莱格里”位于库拉索，而较小的“海员俱乐部”位于圣马丁。

sentences.en: Although the regulations were stringent, it was widely known that much of the sex trade was being run outside the parameters of the law.
sentences.zh: 尽管监管严格，但众所周知，很大一部分性交易是在法律范围之外运作的。

sentences.en: With the demand increasing, a huge influx of women were brought in from other parts of the Americas,
sentences.zh: 随着需求的增加，美洲其他地区的大批女性被带到这里，

sentences.en: many without appropriate permits.
sentences.zh: 其中许多人没有合法证件。

sentences.en: A new type of sex holiday emerged where both men and women would book holiday packages linked to brothels.
sentences.zh: 一种新型的性度假形式出现了，男性和女性都会预订与妓院相关的度假套餐。

sentences.en: And with that came a dark underworld of sex trafficking.
sentences.zh: 随之而来的是性贩运的黑暗地下世界。

sentences.en: Kidnapped people, mostly women, were sold into sex rings.
sentences.zh: 被绑架的人（主要是女性）被卖给贩卖团伙。

sentences.en: They were often drugged and tortured and threatened that they or their families would come to harm if they didn't do what they were told.
sentences.zh: 他们经常被下药和虐待，并受到威胁，如果不听从指示，他们或他们的家人就会受到伤害。

sentences.en: The Bradleys felt this is what happened to Amy.
sentences.zh: 布拉德利一家觉得这就是埃米遭遇的事情。

sentences.en: While waiting for the FBI to arrive in Curacao, they wondered helplessly how Amy could have disappeared in the space of half an hour.
sentences.zh: 在库拉索等待联邦调查局到达期间，他们无助地纳闷埃米怎么会在半小时内消失得无影无踪。

sentences.en: Brad told Ivor and Ron more about Yellow and how he and Amy had been dancing together.
sentences.zh: 布拉德向艾沃和罗恩讲述了更多关于“黄色”的事，以及他和埃米是如何一起跳舞的。

sentences.en: Nothing seemed to make sense, and with such a short time frame of her going missing, it seemed like a bad dream.
sentences.zh: 这一切似乎都说不通，而且她失踪的时间如此之短，感觉就像一场噩梦。

sentences.en: In 1998, the Royal Caribbean's Rhapsody of the Seas was registered in Norway.
sentences.zh: 1998年，皇家加勒比公司的“海洋狂想曲号”在挪威注册。

sentences.en: By being known as a Norwegian flagship, it was governed by the maritime rules of Norway rather than the USA, even though the owners were and still are situated in the US.
sentences.zh: 由于被称为挪威旗舰，它受挪威海事规则而不是美国的管辖，尽管其所有者过去和现在都位于美国。

sentences.en: This is the same for most cruise ships, often flying the flags of Panama,
sentences.zh: 大多数游轮都是如此，它们通常悬挂巴拿马、

sentences.en: Liberia and Greece, just to name a few.
sentences.zh: 利比里亚和希腊等国的旗帜，这只是其中几个例子。

sentences.en: Cruise ships are rarely registered to the USA because if they were, they would be bound by the US maritime laws for building regulations,
sentences.zh: 游轮很少在美国注册，因为如果注册了，它们就会受到美国海事法关于建筑法规、

sentences.en: crew members' nationalities and work permits, minimum wages, working hours and also certain laws when things go wrong.
sentences.zh: 船员国籍和工作许可、最低工资、工作时间以及在出事时的特定法律的约束。

sentences.en: For cruise lines, being registered in the USA is just too costly and too strict.
sentences.zh: 对邮轮公司来说，在美国注册成本太高，限制也太严。

sentences.en: The crew restrictions, ship construction and ownership requirements to flag a vessel in the US are among the most restrictive of the maritime nations.
sentences.zh: 在美国给船只悬挂国旗的船员限制、船舶建造和所有权要求，是海事国家中最严格的之一。

sentences.en: By registering your ship elsewhere, cruise lines pay cheaper or no taxes, get cheaper labour and it can essentially sidestep laws.
sentences.zh: 通过在别处注册船只，邮轮公司可以支付更少或免交税款，获得更便宜的劳动力，并且基本上可以规避法律。

sentences.en: The freedom of the seas law allows a ship to move freely on the ocean as long as it follows the international law and remains governed by its registered country.
sentences.zh: 公海自由法允许船只在海洋上自由航行，只要它遵守国际法并继续受其注册国的管辖。

sentences.en: The Bradleys learnt very quickly that the US government had virtually no jurisdiction over whatever had happened to Amy in the waters just off the coast of Curacao
sentences.zh: 布拉德利一家很快了解到，美国政府对库拉索海岸附近水域发生在她身上的任何事情几乎没有管辖权，

sentences.en: because the Rhapsody of the Seas was within 12 nautical miles of Curacao when Amy went missing.
sentences.zh: 因为埃米失踪时，“海洋狂想曲号”正位于库拉索岛12海里以内。

sentences.en: It wasn't international waters.
sentences.zh: 那不是国际水域。

sentences.en: So the situation was technically in the hands of Curacao police and governed by the maritime laws of Norway.
sentences.zh: 因此，从技术上讲，这种情况掌握在库拉索警方手中，并受挪威海事法的管辖。

sentences.en: In the event of death of an American citizen at sea, that being a relevant death that occurs beyond three nautical miles from shore worldwide,
sentences.zh: 如果美国公民在海上死亡（即在全球范围内距离海岸三海里以外发生的此类死亡），

sentences.en: the Death on the High Seas Act applies.
sentences.zh: 则适用《公海死亡法》。

sentences.en: This is a United States Admiralty law which was created in 1920 to ensure that the widows and children of seamen could get a share of their husbands or fathers' salaries
sentences.zh: 这是一项美国海事法，制定于1920年，旨在确保海员的遗孀和儿童能够分得丈夫或父亲的薪水，

sentences.en: if they were killed at sea.
sentences.zh: 如果他们在海上丧生的话。

sentences.en: But for it to apply at all, shipping companies need to be charged either with negligence or unlawful actions.
sentences.zh: 但要使其完全适用，航运公司需要被控疏忽或违法行为。

sentences.en: At this point, the Bradleys didn't know if Amy was alive or dead and if she fell off the ship, was it beyond three nautical miles from shore?
sentences.zh: 此时，布拉德利一家不知道埃米是生是死，如果她是从船上掉下去的，那是否是在距离海岸三海里以外的地方？

sentences.en: They had no idea and the only people who were willing to help were the FBI and even they had their hands tied.
sentences.zh: 他们一无所知，唯一愿意帮忙的人是联邦调查局，但即使是他们也束手无策。

sentences.en: The Rhapsody of the Seas was self-regulated.
sentences.zh: “海洋狂想曲号”是自我监管的。

sentences.en: There were no investigators or police on board, no policies in place for dealing with an incident of this nature and no legal responsibility to investigate a situation
sentences.zh: 船上没有调查人员或警察，没有应对此类事件的既定政策，也没有法律责任去调查一桩，

sentences.en: that could very well have been an accident or suicide.
sentences.zh: 很可能是事故或自杀的情况。

sentences.en: At the time,
sentences.zh: 当时，

sentences.en: U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: federal law enforcement agencies, including the FBI,
sentences.zh: 联邦执法机构（包括联邦调查局、

sentences.en: Navy and Coast Guard, had to obtain permission from a cruise ship's flag country before beginning a criminal investigation.
sentences.zh: 海军和海岸警卫队）在开始刑事调查之前，必须获得游轮悬挂国旗国家的许可。

sentences.en: U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: agents couldn't just board a cruise ship that may have been the scene of a crime if the ship was located beyond U.S.
sentences.zh: 特工不能仅仅因为游轮位于美国水域之外，就登上可能是犯罪现场的游轮。

sentences.en: waters.
sentences.zh: 水域。

sentences.en: By not getting back aboard the Rhapsody of the Seas, the Bradleys had the ability to call and gain the assistance of the FBI, but they lost all control of what was happening
sentences.zh: 由于没有重新登上“海洋狂想曲号”，布拉德利一家能够打电话并获得联邦调查局的协助，但他们失去了对船上发生事情的控制权

sentences.en: aboard the ship.
sentences.zh: 船上发生的事情。

sentences.en: Security footage, if they had it, access to their cabin and other rooms, preserving evidence.
sentences.zh: 监控录像（如果有的话）、进入他们客舱和其他房间的权限、保护证据。

sentences.en: It was all left in the hands of the ship's crew, who had nearly 2,000 passengers left on board to keep happy.
sentences.zh: 这一切都留给了船上的船员，船上还有近2000名乘客需要他们去安抚。

sentences.en: The following day,
sentences.zh: 第二天，

sentences.en: Wednesday, March 25th, the Bradleys sat helpless in their hotel room in Curacao.
sentences.zh: 3月25日，星期三，布拉德利一家无助地坐在库拉索的酒店房间里。

sentences.en: The FBI phoned and informed them that they would meet them in St. Martin the following day.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局打来电话，通知他们将于次日在圣马丁与他们会合。

sentences.en: The plan was for the Bradleys and the FBI to board the Rhapsody of the Seas together while it was docked in St. Martin.
sentences.zh: 计划是布拉德利一家和联邦调查局一起登上停泊在圣马丁的“海洋狂想曲号”。

sentences.en: The FBI would then meet with the captain and other personnel and conduct their own investigation.
sentences.zh: 然后，联邦调查局将与船长和其他人员会面，并展开他们自己的调查。

sentences.en: While on the phone, the agent told the Bradleys that they had been in touch with some of the ship's crew already.
sentences.zh: 在通话时，特工告诉布拉德利一家，他们已经与船上的一些船员取得了联系。

sentences.en: When they asked the crew about the search they had conducted after Amy went missing, they learnt that the search hadn't been as extensive as what was originally
sentences.zh: 当他们向船员询问埃米失踪后所进行的搜寻工作时，他们得知搜寻工作并不像最初说的那么广泛

sentences.en: made out to the Bradleys.
sentences.zh: 开给布拉德利一家的。

sentences.en: The Bradleys listened as the agent told them that only a cursory search of the common areas and the restrooms had been conducted.
sentences.zh: 布拉德利一家听着特工告诉他们，对公共区域和洗手间只进行了粗略的搜查。

sentences.en: The Bradleys fell apart.
sentences.zh: 布拉德利一家崩溃了。

sentences.en: Back on board the Rhapsody of the Seas, rumours began to circulate that a young woman had committed suicide.
sentences.zh: 回到“海洋狂想曲”号上后，传言开始四处流传，称有一名年轻女子自杀了。

sentences.en: Chris Fenwick was a videographer and editor who had been contracted to work aboard the cruise.
sentences.zh: 克里斯·芬威克是一名摄像师兼剪辑师，他受雇在游轮上工作。

sentences.en: His job was to create an entertaining video of the cruise and edit it on board.
sentences.zh: 他的工作是制作一段有趣的游轮视频，并在船上进行剪辑。

sentences.en: The video would then be shown to guests on the last night and be made available to purchase as a memento.
sentences.zh: 这段视频随后将在最后一天播放给游客观看，并作为纪念品出售。

sentences.en: One of Chris's team members asked him that morning if he had heard about the young woman who ended her life.
sentences.zh: 那天早上，克里斯团队的一名成员问他是否听说过那个结束了自己生命的年轻女子。

sentences.en: Chris's team member had heard about it upstairs from another crew member.
sentences.zh: 克里斯的团队成员是从楼上的另一名船员那里听到这个消息的。

sentences.en: This got Chris wondering if he had footage of the woman.
sentences.zh: 这让克里斯琢磨自己手里有没有这个女子的录像。

sentences.en: He tried to find out more information.
sentences.zh: 他试图找到更多信息。

sentences.en: On Thursday March 26, over 48 hours after the last sighting of Amy,
sentences.zh: 3月26日星期四，在最后一次看到埃米48小时后，

sentences.en: FBI agents boarded the Rhapsody of the Seas in St. Martin together with the Bradleys who had met them there.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局特工在圣马丁登上了“海洋狂想曲”号，与在码头与他们会合的布拉德利一家汇合。

sentences.en: They went directly to the captain, the chief of security,
sentences.zh: 他们径直走向船长、安全主管，

sentences.en: Lou Costello, and to the ship's risk management representative.
sentences.zh: 卢·科斯特洛，以及船上的风险管理代表。

sentences.en: This risk management representative was in fact an attorney for Royal Caribbean International.
sentences.zh: 这位风险管理代表实际上是皇家加勒比国际游轮公司的律师。

sentences.en: While the FBI met with this attorney, the Bradleys were not allowed to be present.
sentences.zh: 当联邦调查局与这位律师会面时，布拉德利一家不被允许在场。

sentences.en: Agents spoke with the Coast Guard who were two days into what would eventually be a three-day air and sea search.
sentences.zh: 特工们与海岸警卫队进行了交谈，海空搜救行动当时已经进行了两天，最终将持续三天。

sentences.en: Despite the captain's belief that Amy had gone overboard quite close to port, the Coast Guard had found no sign of her and nobody had been found washed up along any of the beaches
sentences.zh: 尽管船长认为埃米在离港口很近的地方落水，但海岸警卫队没有发现她的任何踪迹，也没有人在任何海滩上被冲上岸

sentences.en: of Curacao.
sentences.zh: 库拉索的。

sentences.en: The Bradleys felt that the lack of cooperation from the ship's personnel extended to that day in front of the FBI when members of the crew started to grow hostile and defensive.
sentences.zh: 布拉德利一家觉得，船上人员的不配合一直延续到了那天在联邦调查局面前，当时船员开始变得充满敌意和戒备。

sentences.en: The FBI conducted their own search of the ship, including the Bradleys' cabin and other areas.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局对船只进行了他们自己的搜查，包括布拉德利一家的客舱和其他区域。

sentences.en: They surveyed the railing of the cabin and looked for evidence of Amy either falling overboard, going overboard by her own doing, or foul play.
sentences.zh: 他们勘查了客舱的栏杆，寻找埃米意外坠海、自己跳海或遭遇不测的证据。

sentences.en: They then commenced separate interviews with each family member and during these interviews, the ship's attorney was permitted to be present, thus allowing the Royal Caribbean
sentences.zh: 随后，他们开始对每个家庭成员进行单独面谈，在这些面谈中，船上的律师被允许在场，从而使皇家加勒比

sentences.zh: 人员后来能够得知布拉德利一家所说的一切。

sentences.zh: 黄毛坚称他不知道埃米发生了什么事。

sentences.en: He claimed that Amy had a drink in the disco with the band at about 1am, and then he didn't see her after that.
sentences.zh: 他声称埃米大约凌晨1点在迪斯科舞厅和乐队喝了一杯，之后他就没再见过她。

sentences.en: Other crew members, including the waiters who had been in contact with Amy, were also interviewed.
sentences.zh: 其他船员，包括曾与埃米接触过的服务员，也接受了面谈。

sentences.en: That afternoon,
sentences.zh: 那天下午，

sentences.en: They found no reason for Amy to cause harm to herself.

sentences.en: Ron Bradley phoned the FBI agents investigating Amy's case and gave them the witnesses' details.
sentences.zh: 罗恩·布拉德利给负责调查埃米案的联邦调查局特工打了电话，并提供了目击者的详细信息。

sentences.en: With this new information, Ron and Brad made plans to go back to Curacao.
sentences.zh: 有了这些新信息，罗恩和布拉德计划重返库拉索。

sentences.en: Ron's boss helped fund the search and helped put up a reward that was posted on their website.
sentences.zh: 罗恩的上司资助了这次搜寻，并在他们的网站上悬赏。

sentences.en: A $250,000 reward was offered for any information leading to Amy's safe return, as well as a further $50,000 reward for information that pinpointed her verifiable location.
sentences.zh: 悬赏25万美元寻找任何能让埃米安全归还的线索，另外悬赏5万美元寻找能确定她确切可信地点的线索。

sentences.en: Within a few weeks, the Bradleys had hired private detectives to board the Rhapsody of the Seas undercover, but it turned up nothing.
sentences.zh: 几周内，布拉德利夫妇就雇用了私家侦探秘密登上“海洋狂想曲”号，但一无所获。

sentences.en: In desperation, they consulted psychics, which also came up with nothing.
sentences.zh: 绝望之下，他们咨询了灵媒，同样一无所获。

sentences.en: The FBI continued to look into Amy's background.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局继续调查埃米的背景。

sentences.en: After interviewing family and friends, co-workers and school associates, they confirmed once again that they didn't believe Amy had committed suicide.
sentences.zh: 在采访了家人、朋友、同事和学校同学后，他们再次确认不相信埃米是自杀的。

sentences.en: Brad, Ron and Ivor all took polygraph tests, and nothing seemed unusual with the results.
sentences.zh: 布拉德、罗恩和艾沃都接受了测谎仪测试，结果似乎一切正常。

sentences.en: The Bradleys believe that Amy may have been drugged while drinking that coffee or coke in the disco area with yellow,
sentences.zh: 布拉德利夫妇认为，埃米在迪斯科舞厅和黄一起喝那杯咖啡或可乐时可能被下药了，

sentences.en: the drink that the witnesses saw them have together around 6am.
sentences.zh: 也就是目击者看到他们在早上6点左右一起喝的那杯饮料。

sentences.en: Then they believe she was possibly put into the nearby staff elevator in a drugged condition, and then sent to a lower level of the ship.
sentences.zh: 然后他们认为她可能在神志不清的情况下被塞进了附近的员工电梯，接着被送往游轮的底层。

sentences.en: There, she may have been put in a garbage bin or a laundry cart, and smuggled off the ship through a crew door and through the crew's terminal.
sentences.zh: 在那里，她可能被塞进垃圾桶或洗衣车里，通过船员通道和船员码头被偷运下船。

sentences.en: Others believed that Amy may have willingly met with someone and left the ship of her own free will, or she may have been forced off under duress,
sentences.zh: 其他人则认为，埃米可能是自愿与某人见面并出于自由意志离开了船，或者她是在胁迫下被迫离开的，

sentences.en: or that she may have witnessed an illegal activity and somebody panicked.
sentences.zh: 或者她可能目睹了非法活动而有人惊慌失措。

sentences.en: But for the Bradleys, nothing would sway their belief that somebody had her.
sentences.zh: 但对布拉德利一家来说，没有任何事能动摇他们的信念，那就是有人带走了她。

sentences.en: Ivor, quote,
sentences.zh: 艾沃原话：

sentences.en: Somebody saw her, wanted her, and had to have her.
sentences.zh: 有人看到了她，想要她，就必定得到了她。

sentences.en: She would have been a trophy.
sentences.zh: 她会成为一件战利品。

sentences.en: Amy would have been someone that I believe could have been picked out and fingered to move off that ship.
sentences.zh: 我相信埃米可能是被某人选中并点名带离那艘船的人。

sentences.en: She could have been held and hidden.
sentences.zh: 她可能被囚禁并藏匿起来了。

sentences.en: She could have been possibly drugged and taken from that ship.
sentences.zh: 她可能被下药并从那艘船上带走了。

sentences.en: According to the US-based International Cruise Victims Association, which was set up in 2006 by loved ones of several people who had gone missing from cruises,
sentences.zh: 根据总部设在美国的国际游轮受害者协会的数据（该协会由几名在游轮上失踪人员的亲属于2006年创立），

sentences.en: between 1995 and 2012, more than 170 people went missing off cruise ships.
sentences.zh: 在1995年至2012年间，有170多名人员在游轮上失踪。

sentences.en: In 1998, the Bradleys weren't alone in their situation, but there weren't many records or investigations for them to draw on.
sentences.zh: 在1998年，布拉德利一家在他们的处境中并不孤单，但当时可供他们参考的记录或调查并不多。

sentences.en: The murky jurisdictions and laws made their case difficult.
sentences.zh: 模糊不清的管辖权和法律让他们的案子举步维艰。

sentences.en: The Bradleys found it difficult to ignore the possibility that Amy's disappearance may have been linked to sex trafficking.
sentences.zh: 布拉德利夫妇发现很难忽视这样一种可能性：埃米的失踪可能与人口贩卖有关。

sentences.en: According to the UN Refugee Agency, the Netherlands Antilles is a transit and destination point for women and children who are victims of forced sex work
sentences.zh: 根据联合国难民署的数据，荷属安的列斯群岛是强迫性工作受害妇女和儿童的中转站和目的地，

sentences.en: in what is a multi-billion dollar industry.
sentences.zh: 这是一个价值数十亿美元的产业。

sentences.en: They estimate approximately 80% of all sex workers in the Netherlands Antilles are foreigners.
sentences.zh: 他们估计荷属安的列斯群岛大约80%的性工作者都是外国人。

sentences.en: The UN Office on Drugs and Crime lists the Netherlands and Netherlands Antilles as some of the top destinations for victims of human and sex trafficking.
sentences.zh: 联合国毒品和犯罪问题办公室将荷兰和荷属安的列斯群岛列为人口和性贩运受害者的主要目的地之一。

sentences.en: Women who are coerced or kidnapped face inhumane conditions, extreme violence and multiple rapes to break their spirit.
sentences.zh: 被迫或被绑架的女性面临着非人的境遇、极端的暴力以及多次强奸，以摧毁她们的意志。

sentences.en: Victims are often threatened with death, along with the death of their family members should they try to escape, and forced drug dependence is also common.
sentences.zh: 如果受害者试图逃跑，通常会面临死亡威胁以及家人的死亡威胁，被迫产生药物依赖也很常见。

sentences.en: When Ron and Ivor looked back over their time on the Rhapsody of the Seas, they realised the extent of the unusual behaviour of some of the staff towards Amy.
sentences.zh: 当罗恩和艾沃回顾他们在“海洋狂想曲”号上的那段时间时，他们意识到一些员工对埃米异常行为的程度。

sentences.en: They couldn't get past the behaviour of the waiters that first night, the behaviour of Yellow, and even the disappearance of Amy's photographs from the photo gallery.
sentences.zh: 他们无法释怀头天晚上服务员的行为、黄的行为，甚至埃米的照片从相片廊里消失这件事。

sentences.en: To them, they felt she had been targeted.
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，他们觉得她成了被针对的目标。

sentences.en: On April 17th, 1998, three weeks after returning from the Caribbean, the Bradleys put out a public plea for help.
sentences.zh: 1998年4月17日，在从加勒比海回来三周后，布拉德利一家公开呼吁提供帮助。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 原话：

sentences.en: The family of Amy Lynn Bradley, who has been missing since March 24th, 1998, from the cruise ship Rhapsody of the Seas as it arrived at port in Curacao,
sentences.zh: 埃米·琳·布拉德利（Amy Lynn Bradley）的家人在此发出呼吁，她自1998年3月24日“海洋狂想曲”号游轮抵达库拉索港口以来一直失踪，

sentences.en: would like to make the following plea.
sentences.zh: 我们希望发表以下呼吁。

sentences.en: Please let Amy go.
sentences.zh: 请放了埃米吧。

sentences.en: Blindfold her and leave her somewhere safe at night, unharmed.
sentences.zh: 蒙上她的眼睛，把她安然无恙地留在夜里的某个安全地方。

sentences.en: She doesn't know who you are, and only wants to be with her family in her country.
sentences.zh: 她不认识你们是谁，只想和她祖国的家人在一起。

sentences.en: We will ask no questions.
sentences.zh: 我们不会追问任何问题。

sentences.en: You will remain unknown.
sentences.zh: 你们的身份将永远保密。

sentences.en: Please let Amy go.
sentences.zh: 请放了埃米吧。

sentences.en: The Bradleys were 100% adamant she had been abducted.
sentences.zh: 布拉德利夫妇百分之百坚信她是被绑架了。

sentences.en: Ron and Brad made their way back to Curacao, as another taxi driver had come forward, saying that he had been parked at the cruise terminal at Curacao the morning Amy went missing.
sentences.zh: 罗恩和布拉德回到了库拉索，因为又有一名出租车司机站了出来，说埃米失踪那天早上，他把车停在库拉索的游轮码头。

sentences.en: He saw a woman fitting Amy's description looking for a phone.
sentences.zh: 他看到一个符合埃米体貌特征的女人在找电话。

sentences.en: She seemed in a rush, but she didn't seem frantic or scared.
sentences.zh: 她看起来很匆忙，但并不显得惊慌或害怕。

sentences.en: Despite the FBI's intensive investigation, heavy publicity in newspapers and numerous TV shows, like America's Most Wanted, Vanished, and Dr. Phil,
sentences.zh: 尽管联邦调查局进行了深入调查，在报纸上进行了大量宣传，并通过了《全美通缉令》、《消失》和《菲尔博士》等众多电视节目，

sentences.en: as well as numerous news outlets and magazines, nothing of any value had arisen.
sentences.zh: 以及众多新闻媒体和杂志，但没有任何有价值的线索浮出水面。

sentences.en: Amy had simply vanished.
sentences.zh: 埃米就这样凭空消失了。

sentences.en: Once again, Ron and Brad came home with nothing.
sentences.zh: 罗恩和布拉德再次空手而归。

sentences.en: In November that year, seven months after Amy disappeared, the FBI confirmed during an interview with the New York Times that they had nothing.
sentences.zh: 同年11月，即埃米失踪七个月后，联邦调查局在接受《纽约时报》采访时证实他们一无所获。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 原话：

sentences.en: We pursued every angle, from whether there was foul play, a suicide, or an accident, and we have basically not gotten anywhere.
sentences.zh: 我们追查了每一个角度，从是否存在谋杀犯罪、自杀还是意外，基本上毫无进展。

sentences.en: In December that year, eight months after the Bradleys informed the FBI of the phone call they had received from the Puerto Rican man
sentences.zh: 同年12月，也就是布拉德利一家向联邦调查局告知他们接到波多黎各男子电话的八个月后，

sentences.en: who believed he saw Amy being forced into a taxi, they discovered that the FBI never interviewed him.
sentences.zh: 他们发现联邦调查局从未对该男子进行过面谈。

sentences.en: Despite the Bradleys providing proof they forwarded on the information, the FBI denied receiving the lead.
sentences.zh: 尽管布拉德利一家提供了他们转发过该信息的证据，但联邦调查局却否认收到过这条线索。

sentences.en: US Department of Justice agents working with Interpol did go on to interview the man in early 99.
sentences.zh: 与国际刑警组织合作的美国司法部特工确实在99年初对该男子进行了面谈。

sentences.en: He positively identified Amy from a photo lineup as the woman he saw the previous April.
sentences.zh: 他在照片列队中确切地认出了埃米，说她就是他去年四月见过的那个女人。

sentences.en: It wasn't confirmed publicly if he positively identified the man he saw her with.
sentences.zh: 至于他是否确切认出了与她同行的男子，官方并未公开确认。

sentences.en: Given the media saturation of the case by then, including Amy's photo being broadcast everywhere, it's not known how much weight this ID was given.
sentences.zh: 鉴于当时媒体对该案的高度关注，包括埃米的照片到处播出，目前尚不清楚这一辨认结果有多大分量。

sentences.en: Ivor, quote,
sentences.zh: 埃弗尔说，引述：

sentences.en: We had lost time because leads were not followed up.
sentences.zh: 由于线索没有得到跟进，我们错失了时间。

sentences.en: We were told the FBI would leave no stone unturned.
sentences.zh: 我们被告知联邦调查局会不遗余力。

sentences.en: We were confident that they were contacting the witness, following the lead, and tending to everything.
sentences.zh: 我们深信他们正在联系目击者、跟进线索并处理一切事务。

sentences.en: Fed up with getting nowhere with the FBI, the Bradleys wrote to congressmen, foreign officials, and even the president.
sentences.zh: 布雷德利夫妇对联邦调查局毫无进展感到厌烦，于是写信给国会议员、外国官员甚至总统。

sentences.en: They continued to man a 24-hour hotline and kept up the press and plight to find Amy.
sentences.zh: 他们继续维持24小时热线，并不断通过媒体和呼吁来寻找埃米。

sentences.en: They still held the belief that Amy was alive and being held against her will.
sentences.zh: 他们仍然坚信埃米还活着，且被人违背意愿软禁着。

sentences.en: That same month,
sentences.zh: 就在那个月，

sentences.en: Chris Fenwick saw the America's Most Wanted episode on Amy.
sentences.zh: 克里斯·芬威克观看了《头号通缉令》中关于埃米的节目。

sentences.en: He was surprised that the videotape that he had provided Mike McCord, Ron's boss, wasn't used on the show.
sentences.zh: 他很惊讶，他提供给罗恩的上司迈克·麦科德的录像带居然没有在节目中使用。

sentences.en: He began thinking about the conversation he had with the Chief of Security, Lou Costello.
sentences.zh: 他开始回想自己与安全主管卢·科斯特洛的对话。

sentences.en: Costello had been adamant that the FBI wanted the original tapes.
sentences.zh: 科斯特洛曾坚称联邦调查局想要原版录像带。

sentences.en: Chris had given the copy to Ron's boss, who said he passed it on to the FBI, but Chris had never heard from the FBI himself.
sentences.zh: 克里斯把复印件交给了罗恩的上司，对方说已经转交给联邦调查局，但克里斯自己从未接到过联邦调查局的任何消息。

sentences.en: He picked up the phone and left a message for an agent, but he never heard anything back.
sentences.zh: 他拿起电话给一名特工留了言，但却杳无音信。

sentences.en: Another man was also watching
sentences.zh: 当晚，

sentences.en: America's Most Wanted that night.
sentences.zh: 还有另一个男人也在观看《头号通缉令》。

sentences.en: Canadian computer engineer and avid scuba diver,
sentences.zh: 加拿大计算机工程师兼资深水肺潜水员

sentences.en: David Carmichael, came forward immediately after seeing the episode.
sentences.zh: 大卫·卡迈尔在看完这期节目后立即站了出来。

sentences.en: He and another scuba diving friend were on a beach in Curacao in August of that year, approximately five months after Amy disappeared.
sentences.zh: 当年8月，也就是埃米失踪大约五个月后，他和另一个潜水朋友在库拉索岛的一个海滩上。

sentences.en: David Carmichael, quote,
sentences.zh: 大卫·卡迈尔说，引述：

sentences.en: I noticed three people walking along the beach.
sentences.zh: 我注意到有三个人沿着海滩走过来。

sentences.en: One of them was a young girl and she was flanked by two fellows.
sentences.zh: 其中一个是年轻女孩，两侧各有一个男子陪着。

sentences.en: She had two tattoos.
sentences.zh: 她身上有两个纹身。

sentences.en: One of them was of a gecko.
sentences.zh: 一个是壁虎图案。

sentences.en: The other was of a Tasmanian devil.
sentences.zh: 另一个是塔斯马尼亚恶魔图案。

sentences.en: The girl walked towards me.
sentences.zh: 那个女孩朝我走来。

sentences.en: She started to stare at me.
sentences.zh: 她开始盯着我看。

sentences.en: Just as she was about to say something, she looked frightened, like she was about to say something when one of the guys motioned her away and gave me a menacing look.
sentences.zh: 正当她要说些什么时，她看起来很惊恐，好像正要开口，其中一个家伙却示意她走开，并恶狠狠地瞪了我一眼。

sentences.en: I was stunned.
sentences.zh: 我当时惊呆了。

sentences.en: The minute I saw her picture and saw her face on the program, I realized that was the girl on the beach.
sentences.zh: 一看到节目中她的照片和脸庞，我就意识到那就是海滩上的那个女孩。

sentences.en: I am haunted by that encounter with Amy.
sentences.zh: 那次与埃米的偶遇一直萦绕在我的脑海中挥之不去。

sentences.en: I know it was her.
sentences.zh: 我知道那就是她。

sentences.en: David Carmichael flew to Virginia to meet the Bradleys.
sentences.zh: 大卫·卡迈尔飞往弗吉尼亚州与布雷德利夫妇见面。

sentences.en: Although Amy's family had a feeling that she was still alive, they started legal proceedings in late 1998 in order to have Amy declared dead.
sentences.zh: 尽管埃米的家人有一种她还活着的感觉，但他们还是在1998年底启动了法律程序，以宣告埃米死亡。

sentences.en: In June 99, their wish was granted.
sentences.zh: 1999年6月，他们的愿望得到了满足。

sentences.en: This allowed them to pursue legal proceedings against Royal Caribbean Cruises.
sentences.zh: 这使他们能够对皇家加勒比游轮公司采取法律行动。

sentences.en: The Bradleys filed a lawsuit against Royal Caribbean Cruises Limited, alleging negligent security, defamation, and intentional infliction of emotional distress.
sentences.zh: 布雷德利夫妇对皇家加勒比游轮有限公司提起诉讼，指控其安保疏忽、诽谤以及蓄意造成精神痛苦。

sentences.en: But in November 99, the judge dismissed all lawsuits against the cruise line, as the Bradleys were accused of perjury and committing fraud in court.
sentences.zh: 但在1999年11月，法官驳回了针对该游轮公司的所有诉讼，因为布雷德利夫妇被指控在法庭上作伪证和欺诈。

sentences.en: When presenting evidence, the Bradleys stated that they only had three witnesses who had seen Amy since she disappeared.
sentences.zh: 在出示证据时，布雷德利夫妇声称他们只有三位目击者在埃米失踪后见过她。

sentences.en: All three said she was under duress.
sentences.zh: 这三人均表示她处于胁迫之下。

sentences.en: But what they withheld was that they actually had over 100 eyewitness sightings reported of Amy living on the island of her own free will, not under any duress.
sentences.zh: 但他们隐瞒的是，实际上他们收到了100多起目击报告，称埃米自愿住在岛上，并未受到任何胁迫。

sentences.en: These extra sightings could have indicated to the court that Amy, if it was her who the witnesses saw, may have left the cruise on her own free will.
sentences.zh: 这些额外的目击情况本可以向法庭表明，如果目击者看到的人确实是埃米，她可能是自愿离开游轮的。

sentences.en: The court ruled that the Bradleys misdirected the court in an attempt to portray that the only explanation for Amy's disappearance was that she was abducted.
sentences.zh: 法庭裁定，布雷德利夫妇误导了法庭，企图将埃米失踪的唯一解释描绘为她遭到了绑架。

sentences.en: Despite the setback, the Bradleys continued to search for answers.
sentences.zh: 尽管遭遇挫折，布雷德利夫妇仍继续寻找答案。

sentences.en: The Bradleys had also heard from a woman in Curacao, a local cook named Judith Margaretha.
sentences.zh: 布雷德利夫妇还听说了库拉索岛的一位女性，当地厨师朱迪思·玛格丽塔。

sentences.en: She believed Amy was being held by heavily armed Colombian guards in a housing complex protected with barbed wire.
sentences.zh: 她相信埃米被手持重武器的哥伦比亚警卫关在一个有铁丝网保护的住宅区里。

sentences.en: She also said that she regularly saw Amy shopping at a grocery store and working out at a gym, and that she was often with a man with long blonde hair
sentences.zh: 她还说，她经常看到埃米在杂货店购物、在健身房锻炼，而且埃米经常和一个留着长金发

sentences.en: and tattoos all the way down one arm.
sentences.zh: 且一条手臂布满纹身的男子在一起。

sentences.en: Judith was able to give the Bradleys an accurate description of tattoos that Amy had.
sentences.zh: 朱迪思能够向布雷德利夫妇准确描述埃米身上的纹身。

sentences.en: But it was when Judith hummed a lullaby that Ivor used to sing to Amy when she was a baby that the Bradleys were completely convinced she was telling the truth.
sentences.zh: 但直到朱迪思哼起了埃米小时候埃弗尔常唱给她的摇篮曲，布雷德利夫妇才彻底相信她说的是实话。

sentences.en: Officials on the island told the Bradleys they could do nothing with the information because there was no evidence of a crime, and the investigation by the FBI
sentences.zh: 岛上的官员告诉布雷德利夫妇，他们无法根据这些信息采取任何行动，因为没有犯罪证据，而且联邦调查局的调查

sentences.en: had made little progress, so it wasn't a priority.
sentences.zh: 进展甚微，因此这并非首要任务。

sentences.en: While Ron and Ivor were deciding what to do and how they should deal with the information they had been given by Judith, they received an email from a man named Frank Jones.
sentences.zh: 正当罗恩和埃弗尔在商量该做些什么、以及如何处理朱迪思提供给他们的信息时，他们收到了一名叫弗兰克·琼斯的男子的电子邮件。

sentences.en: Jones told the Bradleys he was a former
sentences.zh: 琼斯告诉布雷德利夫妇，他曾是一名

sentences.en: U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: Army Special Forces officer with a team made up of ex-Army Rangers and ex-Navy SEALs who might be able to help rescue Amy.
sentences.zh: 陆军特种部队军官，手下有一支由前陆军游骑兵和前海军海豹突击队员组成的团队，或许能够协助营救埃米。

sentences.en: When the Bradleys told him about the information they had received from Judith,
sentences.zh: 当布雷德利夫妇将他们从朱迪思那里得到的信息告诉他时，

sentences.en: Jones offered to act as a private investigator in order to scope out the situation and then carry out a stealth mission to rescue her.
sentences.zh: 琼斯主动提出担任私人调查员，以便侦察情况，随后执行秘密任务营救她。

sentences.en: Ivor, quote,
sentences.zh: 埃弗尔说，引述：

sentences.en: He told me that he'd put
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，他会把

sentences.en: Amy on his own back and swim her out of there.
sentences.zh: 埃米背在自己背上，把她从那里游着救出来。

sentences.en: His team had the experience and credentials to rescue Amy.
sentences.zh: 他的团队拥有营救埃米的经验和资历。

sentences.en: The Bradleys felt that their prayers had finally been answered and they agreed to hire Frank Jones.
sentences.zh: 布雷德利夫妇觉得他们的祈祷终于得到了回应，并同意雇用弗兰克·琼斯。

sentences.en: In order to do so, they had to sell their car and Ron's boss also chipped in.
sentences.zh: 为了支付费用，他们不得不卖掉汽车，罗恩的上司也出资相助。

sentences.en: In the year that had passed since Amy disappeared, the Bradleys and the FBI continued to get leads which all ended up going nowhere.
sentences.zh: 在埃米失踪后的这一年里，布雷德利夫妇和联邦调查局不断获得各种线索，但最终都无果而终。

sentences.en: But this information from Judith seemed different and Ron and Ivor's gut feeling told them it was going to lead to Amy.
sentences.zh: 但朱迪思提供的这些信息似乎有所不同，罗恩和埃弗尔的直觉告诉他们，这将会找到埃米。

sentences.en: Frank Jones sent two of his men, former Navy SEALs, down to Curacao to check out the information given by Judith.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克·琼斯派了他的两名手下（前海军海豹突击队员）前往库拉索岛，以核实朱迪思提供的信息。

sentences.en: Shortly after,
sentences.zh: 不久之后，

sentences.en: Jones sent the Bradleys a report saying that he believed Amy was in a dangerous situation and was under guard.
sentences.zh: 琼斯向布雷德利夫妇发了一份报告，称他相信埃米处于危险之中并受到看守。

sentences.en: They had attempted to set up surveillance points at the locations
sentences.zh: 他们试图在

sentences.en: Judith had given and they had seen Amy being driven by her kidnapper, believed to be a man with long blonde hair and one arm sleeved with tattoos in a dark green SUV.
sentences.zh: 朱迪思给出的地点建立监控点，并看到埃米被她的绑架者（据信是一个留着长金发、一条手臂纹满纹身的男人）用一辆深绿色SUV载着。

sentences.en: But Jones and his men were forced to flee for a week after being fired upon by around 10 men.
sentences.zh: 但在遭到大约10人的开枪射击后，琼斯和他的手下被迫逃亡了一周。

sentences.en: Things had gotten serious but knowing Amy was alive gave the Bradleys some level of comfort.
sentences.zh: 事情变得严重了，但得知埃米还活着，给布雷德利夫妇带来了一定程度的安慰。

sentences.en: The next few months were brutal.
sentences.zh: 接下来的几个月极其残酷。

sentences.en: They constantly felt that Amy was in imminent danger and may be killed at any moment.
sentences.zh: 他们时刻感觉到埃米处于迫在眉睫的危险之中，随时可能被杀害。

sentences.en: They wanted Jones to get her out immediately but they needed to trust him and his men.
sentences.zh: 他们希望琼斯立即把她救出来，但他们需要信任他和他的手下。

sentences.en: It wasn't the right time.
sentences.zh: 时机还不成熟。

sentences.en: It was too dangerous.
sentences.zh: 太危险了。

sentences.en: Over the following months,
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几个月里，

sentences.en: Jones sent two more of his operatives to the island and provided a series of reports to the Bradleys on the whereabouts of Amy.
sentences.zh: 琼斯又派了两名特工上岛，并向布雷德利夫妇提供了一系列关于埃米下落的报告。

sentences.en: The Bradleys continued to wait, hoping that the next day would be the day
sentences.zh: 布雷德利夫妇继续等待，希望第二天就是

sentences.en: Amy would be rescued and they would be a complete family again.
sentences.zh: 埃米获救、他们一家人破镜重圆的日子。

sentences.en: In 1999, there was another possible sighting of Amy in Curacao.
sentences.zh: 1999年，库拉索岛又出现了可能看到埃米的目击事件。

sentences.en: This man didn't want any reward money but his conscience had gotten the better of him.
sentences.zh: 这名男子不想要任何悬赏金，但他的良心受到了谴责。

sentences.en: He was an American sailor who stopped off in Curacao and visited a brothel, something he wasn't supposed to be doing.
sentences.zh: 他是一名美国水手，在库拉索岛短暂停留期间去了一家妓院，这是他不该做的事。

sentences.en: At the brothel, he claimed he approached two women sitting at a table and one of them told him her name was Amy Bradley and she began begging for help.
sentences.zh: 在妓院里，他声称自己走近两个坐在桌旁的女人，其中一个告诉他她叫埃米·布雷德利，并开始恳求帮助。

sentences.en: He told her there was a Navy ship just down the road but she said, you don't understand.
sentences.zh: 他告诉她附近就有一艘海军军舰，但她说，你还不明白。

sentences.en: I can't leave.
sentences.zh: 我走不了。

sentences.en: Help me.
sentences.zh: 救救我。

sentences.en: Please help me.
sentences.zh: 求求你救救我。

sentences.en: He said he dismissed her plea because he wasn't aware
sentences.zh: 他说他没有理会她的恳求，因为他不知道

sentences.en: Amy was a missing person and he was also worried his superiors would find out he was there.
sentences.zh: 埃米是个失踪人口，而且他也担心上司会发现他在那里。

sentences.en: But after he saw the picture of Amy in People magazine, he recalled that after pleading with him to help her, the woman was escorted forcibly upstairs by two men.
sentences.zh: 但当他在《人物》杂志上看到埃米的照片后，他想起那个女人在恳求他帮忙之后，被两个男人强行带到了楼上。

sentences.en: When investigators went to check on the brothel, it had burnt down.
sentences.zh: 当调查人员前去查证那家妓院时，它已经被烧毁了。

sentences.en: It was around this time
sentences.zh: 正是在这个时候，

sentences.en: Chris Fenwick received a call from his brother who had seen a rerun of the TV segment on Amy on Unsolved Mysteries.
sentences.zh: 克里斯·芬威克接到他兄弟的电话，他兄弟在《未解之谜》节目中看到了关于埃米的那段电视节目的重播。

sentences.en: Once again, the dance floor video wasn't used by the show.
sentences.zh: 节目中依然没有使用那段舞池录像。

sentences.en: Chris' brother took it upon himself to call the network and ask if they were aware of the dance floor video.
sentences.zh: 克里斯的兄弟自作主张给电视台打电话，询问他们是否知道舞池录像的事。

sentences.en: A few days later,
sentences.zh: 几天后，

sentences.en: Chris' brother got a call from Ivor Bradley.
sentences.zh: 克里斯的兄弟接到了埃弗尔·布雷德利打来的电话。

sentences.en: He was shocked to learn that the Bradleys had never seen the video.
sentences.zh: 得知布雷德利夫妇从未看过这段录像，他感到很震惊。

sentences.en: Chris immediately made a copy for them.
sentences.zh: 克里斯立即为他们复制了一份。

sentences.en: It was almost a year and a half since he attempted to give it to them the first time.
sentences.zh: 距离他第一次尝试把录像交给他俩已经过去了一年半左右。

sentences.en: The remainder of 1999 and the year 2000 was excruciating for the Bradleys.
sentences.zh: 1999年的剩余时间以及2000年对布雷德利夫妇来说是痛苦难熬的。

sentences.en: Frank Jones continued his surveillance and kept them up to speed.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克·琼斯继续进行监视，并随时向他们通报最新进展。

sentences.en: His surveillance validated Judith's information.
sentences.zh: 他的监视证实了朱迪思提供的信息。

sentences.en: It seemed what she had seen was legit.
sentences.zh: 看来她看到的情况是真的。

sentences.en: The continued surveillance and the additional operatives cost Ron and Ivor more money every month but they kept going.
sentences.zh: 持续的监视和增派特工每个月都要花掉罗恩和埃弗尔更多的钱，但他们咬牙坚持了下来。

sentences.en: They had spent all their savings by this point and accepted help from donors and non-profit organizations that were willing to help.
sentences.zh: 此时他们已经花光了所有的积蓄，并接受了捐赠者和愿意提供帮助的非营利组织的援助。

sentences.en: Eventually, the Bradleys received word from Jones that he was ready to launch the rescue mission.
sentences.zh: 最终，布雷德利夫妇收到琼斯的消息，称他已经准备好发起营救任务。

sentences.en: He just needed the final payment so he could arrange his team.
sentences.zh: 他只需要尾款来安排他的团队。

sentences.en: With the financial help and the advice of Ron's boss,
sentences.zh: 在罗恩上司的资金援助和建议下，

sentences.en: Ron and Ivor asked Jones for some kind of proof that Amy was still alive so he sent them a photo.
sentences.zh: 罗恩和埃弗尔要求琼斯提供某种证明，证明埃米还活着，于是他发给他们一张照片。

sentences.en: It was of a young woman sitting on the beach with her back to the camera.
sentences.zh: 照片上是一个年轻女子背对镜头坐在海滩上。

sentences.en: The man next to her had long blonde hair and a sleeve tattoo on his arm.
sentences.zh: 她身旁的男子留着长金发，手臂上有满袖纹身。

sentences.en: The woman was wearing a wide-brimmed hat so he couldn't see her face but the tattoos were unmistakable.
sentences.zh: 由于那女人戴着一顶宽檐帽，所以看不到她的脸，但纹身是绝对错不了的。

sentences.en: They were all there.
sentences.zh: 它们都在那儿。

sentences.en: When Ivor saw the picture she knew it was Amy.
sentences.zh: 当埃弗尔看到这张照片时，她知道那就是埃米。

sentences.en: Ivor quote
sentences.zh: 埃弗尔说，引述：

sentences.en: When I got the pictures I knew Amy was okay and it was just a matter of time.
sentences.zh: 当我拿到照片时，我知道埃米没事了，这只是时间问题。

sentences.en: The Bradleys arranged the final payment and flew to Florida to wait in the hotel room to hear word from Jones.
sentences.zh: 布雷德利夫妇安排了尾款，然后飞往佛罗里达州在酒店房间里等待琼斯的消息。

sentences.en: He said he would call to let them know the rescue had been successful.
sentences.zh: 他说他会打电话通知他们营救成功。

sentences.en: As a donation from Ron's boss the Bradleys had a private jet on standby so that they could immediately fly out the Curacao to meet Amy when she was rescued.
sentences.zh: 作为罗恩上司的捐赠，布雷德利夫妇备有一架私人飞机，以便在埃米获救时能立即飞往库拉索岛与她会合。

sentences.en: The Bradleys sat in the hotel room for a week waiting for the phone call.
sentences.zh: 布雷德利夫妇在酒店房间里呆坐了一个星期，等待电话。

sentences.en: They were so anxious that they hardly left the room.
sentences.zh: 他们焦虑万分，几乎没离开过房间。

sentences.en: In Curacao one of Jones' men a former
sentences.zh: 在库拉索岛，琼斯的手下之一、前

sentences.en: Army Special Forces sniper
sentences.zh: 陆军特种部队狙击手

sentences.en: Tim Buchholz had been noticing over time that Jones was telling the Bradleys things that weren't true.
sentences.zh: 蒂姆·布赫霍尔茨渐渐发现，琼斯一直在对布雷德利夫妇说谎。

sentences.en: When Buchholz was on duty watching the house where Amy was supposedly being held he never saw any sign of her.
sentences.zh: 当布赫霍尔茨在值班监视据称关押着埃米的房子时，他从未看到过她的任何踪迹。

sentences.en: The residents of the house appeared to be regular people and he hadn't seen anything suspicious.
sentences.zh: 那栋房子的居民看起来像是普通人，他也没有看到任何可疑情况。

sentences.en: But he later overheard Jones on the phone in a bar drinking telling the Bradleys that his people were watching the house at that very moment.
sentences.zh: 但后来他在一家酒吧喝酒时无意中听到琼斯在电话里告诉布雷德利夫妇，说他的人此刻正在监视那栋房子。

sentences.en: Buchholz's heart sunk as he realised.
sentences.zh: 意识到这一点的瞬间，布赫霍尔茨的心沉了下去。

sentences.en: It was all a lie.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是谎言。

sentences.en: Buchholz contacted the Bradleys who were still desperately waiting in Florida for word from Jones.
sentences.zh: 布赫霍尔茨联系了布雷德利夫妇，当时他们仍在佛罗里达州绝望地等待着琼斯的音讯。

sentences.en: He had to tell them that Frank Jones had lied to them.
sentences.zh: 他不得不告诉他们，弗兰克·琼斯欺骗了他们。

sentences.en: Some of the operatives employed by Jones were legitimate.
sentences.zh: 琼斯雇用的某些特工确实是真的。

sentences.en: Those that were were unaware until that point what they were involved in.
sentences.zh: 那些人在此之前并不知道自己卷入了什么当中。

sentences.en: happened.
sentences.zh: 事情就这样发生了。

sentences.en: They had paid Jones approximately
sentences.zh: 他们向琼斯支付了大约

sentences.en: $24,000 of their own personal savings and over
sentences.zh: 24000美元的个人积蓄，以及来自

sentences.en: $180,000 from the
sentences.zh: 全国

sentences.en: Amy Bradley fund at the nation's
